represents.evidence: Two pink spheres overlapping into one organic lump; the melt is implied but the join is a hard crease, not a smooth neck.
represents.fix: Add a visible smooth blend neck (filleted waist) between the two spheres so they clearly melt together, and add a third smaller sphere fused on.

distinct.evidence: Pink and organic, unlike the grey hard-edged Primitive; only other pink icons are on other sheets.
distinct.fix: Keep pink; add a small red highlight band at the blend neck to mark the melt action.

legibility.evidence: Silhouette reads at 1x as a double sphere; no red accent marks the action.
legibility.fix: Add a red accent on the blend seam so the action reads at 1x.

craft.evidence: Clean outline and shading, slight dithering on the shadow side.
craft.fix: Reduce dither noise on the darker sphere and keep one clean shading ramp.

represents.evidence: Cream paper with dark scribble lines and a yellow pencil: drawing on paper reads.
represents.fix: Draw one bold red closed shape (rectangle or circle) on the paper instead of thin scribbles, pencil tip touching it.

distinct.evidence: Same paper-on-table setup as #3 Profile next to it.
distinct.fix: Make the pencil much larger and diagonal across the sheet so pencil is the key part, unlike Profile.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the lines and pencil are 1-px thin and blur into the paper.
legibility.fix: Thicken the pencil to 3+ px and the drawn stroke to 2 px red.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, but small and lots of empty frame.
craft.fix: Scale the paper up to fill the cell.

represents.evidence: Paper with a grey block on it and a red line along one edge; reads as a block on a sheet, not a 2D cross-section outline.
represents.fix: Remove the grey block; draw a bold red closed L or T-shaped outline on the paper (flat 2D profile), optionally with a faint ghost extrusion above it.

distinct.evidence: Nearly the same paper composition as #2 Sketch.
distinct.fix: Drop the paper: stand the red profile outline upright on its own like a cutout, so it differs from Sketch.

legibility.evidence: At 1x it's a grey smudge on cream; the red outline is a thin sliver.
legibility.fix: Make the profile outline 2 px red and the shape large in the frame.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, some muddy red/grey overlap.
craft.fix: Separate red outline from grey fill with clear spacing.

represents.evidence: Red S-curve with yellow end points and black tangent handles: a spline.
represents.fix: Add a yellow control point in the middle of the curve with its handle, so 'through control points' reads.

distinct.evidence: Unique on the Form sheet; nearest is Curve (#16) on Deform.
distinct.fix: Keep the bare curve with no body attached to stay distinct from Curve.

legibility.evidence: Curve reads at 1x but the black handle lines vanish into the dark wheel.
legibility.fix: Make handles light grey 1-px lines with 2x2 yellow dots at their ends.

craft.evidence: Clean curve, handle lines look like stray black pixels.
craft.fix: Recolour handles so they don't read as noise.

represents.evidence: Cream block, red arrow, grey cube: cream block doesn't read as a file.
represents.fix: Make the source a paper sheet with a folded corner (file), red arrow pointing INTO the grey cube.

distinct.evidence: Near mirror of #34 Export (cube, red dot, cream block).
distinct.fix: Change layout: file on top dropping down into an open box/tray, arrow pointing down, so it can't be confused with Export.

legibility.evidence: Three parts read at 1x but the arrow is a red dot, direction unclear.
legibility.fix: Make a proper red arrow with a 3-px head showing direction.

craft.fix: Tighten the composition and overlap the parts slightly.

represents.evidence: Bone with a pink flesh blob on its middle and a red up arrow: flesh around a bone reads.
represents.fix: Wrap the flesh along most of the bone length as a capsule with bone ends sticking out, red arrows pointing outward from the bone.

distinct.evidence: Bone ends differ from Primitive/Part; close cousin of Bind on Rig sheet.
distinct.fix: Make flesh larger relative to bone so it reads as a body, not a bone with a marker.

legibility.evidence: Readable at 1x; the red arrow is small.
legibility.fix: Bigger red arrows (2) growing outward.

craft.fix: Minor: trim the single-px arrow shaft to 2 px.

represents.evidence: Stack of stepped grey tiers with a red disc on top: reads as a stepped pyramid/cake, no blend between different sections.
represents.fix: Show a square red profile at the base and a round red profile at the top with one smooth skin blending square-to-round between them; remove the steps.

distinct.evidence: Close to Extrude (block on plate) and Draft (tapered).
distinct.fix: The square-to-circle smooth transition makes it unique; drop the base plate.

legibility.evidence: Silhouette clear at 1x, red top visible.
legibility.fix: Keep two red profiles strongly visible at each end.

craft.fix: Smooth single surface removes the clutter.

represents.evidence: Curved grey tube with a red ring end and thin red path line: sweep along path reads.
represents.fix: Make the red path a bold rail running the full length and extending ahead of the tube, with the red profile ring at the leading end.

distinct.evidence: Grey curved tube resembles Bend (#15) arc.
distinct.fix: Make the path S-shaped and visible beyond the tube end so it isn't just a bent bar.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the tube is small and the path is 1 px.
legibility.fix: Scale the tube up and thicken the red path to 2 px.

represents.evidence: Ring of grey cylinders around a red circle: circular pattern reads.
represents.fix: Add a red curved arrow around the ring to show repetition around the circle.

distinct.evidence: Uses the same cylinders as Row pattern next to it; layout differs.
distinct.fix: Use a different instance shape (small cubes) or make the red circle bolder.

legibility.evidence: At 1x eight cylinders crowd into a blob.
legibility.fix: Use 6 larger copies with gaps between.

represents.evidence: Grey box with a red rounded edge band: rounded edge reads.
represents.fix: Show the round as a clear quarter-circle profile on the side face so the radius is obvious.

distinct.evidence: Box-with-red-edge setup similar to Chamfer, but rounded vs triangular.
distinct.fix: Make the rounded edge larger radius so it contrasts with Chamfer's flat cut.

legibility.evidence: Red rounded top reads at 1x.
legibility.fix: Minor: brighten the highlight on the round.

represents.evidence: Red truncated pyramid with a dark tip: reads as a pyramid/cone, not a draft angle on walls.

distinct.evidence: Similar to Push face's dark spike and Loft's tapered stack.

legibility.evidence: Red shape reads at 1x; the meaning doesn't.

represents.evidence: Grey slab sitting on a red plane: the cut and the kept side aren't clear.
represents.fix: Show a block sliced by a red plane through its middle, top half kept, bottom half shown as a faint ghost or falling away.

distinct.evidence: Close to Plane (grey sheet) and Section (red cut face).
distinct.fix: Show the discarded half separated to distinguish from Section.

legibility.evidence: At 1x a grey lump on a red smear.
legibility.fix: Larger block, crisp red plane edge.

craft.evidence: Red plane is a bit muddy/dithered.
craft.fix: Flat red plane with clean outline.

represents.evidence: Pink soft pad with a small tool tip poking it.
represents.fix: Larger sculpt brush/loop tool and a clear raised bump or dent under it.

distinct.evidence: Unique on the Deform sheet.
distinct.fix: Keep pink clay; add red accent on the dent.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the tool is a few pixels; looks like a pink dish.
legibility.fix: Tool at least a third of the icon height.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, flat pad lacks form.
craft.fix: Add shading to show the surface deformation.

represents.evidence: Three-axis gizmo with red, yellow and blue arrows.
represents.fix: Add a small rotation ring to cover rotate.

distinct.evidence: Nothing else on the sheet looks like a gizmo.
distinct.fix: Keep.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the blue arrow is dark against the wheel and the centre is tiny.
legibility.fix: Brighten blue arrow, bigger arrowheads and centre cube.

represents.evidence: Grey bar bent into an arch with a red curved arrow above.
represents.fix: Add a faint straight ghost bar to show before/after.

distinct.evidence: Arch resembles Sweep's curved tube.
distinct.fix: Make it a square-section bar to differ from Sweep's round tube.

legibility.evidence: Reads at 1x.
legibility.fix: Bigger arrowhead.

represents.evidence: Lumpy grey chain over a thin red line: body following curve is weakly suggested.
represents.fix: Make a thicker smooth grey bar clearly bent along a bold red S curve with yellow control dots at the ends.

distinct.evidence: Overlaps Spline and Sweep in idea and look.

legibility.evidence: At 1x it's a thin squiggle, segments merge.

represents.evidence: Cube with a red slanted strip cut into the front: reads as a slot or mouth, not a bevelled edge.

distinct.evidence: Close to Loop cut (red line on cube) and Chamfer/Fillet.

legibility.evidence: Red is visible at 1x but the shape is ambiguous.

craft.evidence: Ragged dark gap under the red strip.

represents.evidence: Red mirror plane with a grey object on one side.
represents.fix: Show one solid half and a matching red-outline copy on the other side with an arrow across the plane.

distinct.evidence: Red plane plus grey shape is the same idea as Mirror and close to Symmetry check.
distinct.fix: Use a mesh cube half with visible vertices/edges, so it's mesh-specific, not Mirror.

legibility.evidence: At 1x a muddle of red and grey.
legibility.fix: Plane edge-on vertical line, halves clearly separated.

craft.evidence: Grey shape is lumpy and unclear.

represents.evidence: Dark tile with a light grid pattern: doesn't show removing edges.

distinct.evidence: Different from cube icons, close to Topology grid.

legibility.evidence: At 1x a dark speckled tile.

represents.evidence: Cube with a big red X over it.
represents.fix: Show highlighted selected verts/edges with the X over them.

distinct.evidence: Close to Delete face (cube with red face).
distinct.fix: Show elements missing (a gap) with the X, distinct from the single red face.

legibility.evidence: X reads at 1x.
legibility.fix: Minor: bolder X.

represents.evidence: Blue fabric patch with a thin yellow-edged strip at the top; the flap is barely visible and it reads as a label or plain patch.

distinct.evidence: Flat blue patch looks like Fabric and Wear on the same sheet.
distinct.fix: Give the pocket visible thickness and a shadow so it stands off the base cloth, unlike flat Fabric/Wear.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the flap is a 1-px yellow line and the pocket disappears into the patch.
legibility.fix: Enlarge the pocket to half the patch and make the flap edge a 2-px contrasting line.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, but the composition is mostly empty blue.
craft.fix: Crop the base fabric smaller so the pocket fills the frame.

represents.evidence: Blue fabric with a dark heart-shaped hole and a tiny red dot: a hole reads, fray/scuff not.

distinct.evidence: The hole separates it from Fabric/Pocket, though the base patch is the same.
distinct.fix: Tear a corner of the patch off too so the silhouette itself differs.

legibility.fix: Enlarge the hole to a third of the patch and make the red rim 2 px.

craft.evidence: Clean outline; heart-shaped hole looks cute rather than worn.
craft.fix: Make the hole an irregular jagged shape.

represents.evidence: Pink skin base with dense yellow strands growing up: fur reads.
represents.fix: Use fewer, longer strands that curve and lean in one direction like groomed hair.

distinct.evidence: Nothing else on the Cloth sheet has strands.
distinct.fix: Keep the strands; recolour the base to blue fabric-free pink so it stays separate.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the strands merge into a yellow block like a brush.
legibility.fix: Thicken each strand to 2 px with 1-px gaps; 6-8 strands total.

craft.evidence: Busy jagged strand tops, slightly noisy.
craft.fix: Taper each strand to a clean point.

represents.evidence: Pink block with a bite cut showing red interior: flesh reads, layering weak.
represents.fix: Show distinct layers in the cut: thin pink skin, yellow fat band, red muscle core.

distinct.evidence: Different from Material sphere and Face material cube; pink like Skin.
distinct.fix: Keep the block shape; the layered cut separates it from Skin's flat oval.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the red cut reads as a notch.
legibility.fix: Make the cut deeper and wider, a quarter wedge removed.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, red interior a bit muddy.
craft.fix: Flat colour bands instead of dither in the cut.

represents.evidence: Pink oval with faint pale spots: details barely suggested.
represents.fix: Add darker brown freckles (2x2 px), a few pore dots, and a small magnifying lens over part of the skin.

distinct.evidence: Pink oval resembles Blob and Sculpt pads.
distinct.fix: The lens and brown freckles make it unique; flatten to a square swatch.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the spots vanish, leaving a plain pink oval.
legibility.fix: High-contrast brown spots, at least 2x2 px each.

craft.evidence: Clean outline, spots look like smudges.

represents.evidence: Grey cube on one end, dark slider bar with yellow handle, pink sphere at the other: blend idea present but reads like a tool/rod.
represents.fix: Make an obvious slider track (light rail) with a red handle mid-way, cube at the left stop and sphere at the right stop.

distinct.evidence: Same rod-and-sphere parts as Key end next to it.
distinct.fix: Keep shape key horizontal with handle centred; give Key end a different composition.

legibility.evidence: At 1x the handle is a few yellow px.
legibility.fix: Handle 3x4 px in red.

craft.fix: Lighten the track so it doesn't merge with the dark wheel.

represents.evidence: Dark rod ending in a yellow collar and a red ring around a pink ball: reads as a magnifier/lollipop, not a slider end stop.
represents.fix: Show the slider track ending in a red end-bracket with the handle docked against it and the target shape (sphere) beyond.

distinct.evidence: Shares rod + pink sphere with Shape key.
distinct.fix: Remove the rod-ball look; use the bracket stop as the dominant shape.

legibility.evidence: Ring reads at 1x.
legibility.fix: Make the stop bracket 3 px thick red.

craft.fix: Shorten the thin dark rod that blends into the background.

represents.evidence: Cream paper with a grey knob and red mark: setting a parameter is unclear.
represents.fix: Replace with a large dial knob with tick marks and a red pointer, or a slider with a red handle.

distinct.evidence: Different from Remove bin and Remedy box.
distinct.fix: Keep away from cream paper used by Sketch/Topology.

legibility.evidence: At 1x it's a tiny cream square with specks.

craft.evidence: Muddy small details on the paper.
craft.fix: Remove the paper, one clean dial.

represents.evidence: Grey cube with a red crack and a yellow wrench: repair reads.
represents.fix: Make the wrench bigger, crossing the cube, and show the crack half-patched.

distinct.evidence: Differs from Remedy's first-aid box.
distinct.fix: Keep grey mesh cube.

legibility.evidence: Wrench thin at 1x.
legibility.fix: Wrench 3 px thick.

represents.evidence: Blue butterfly with a red centre line: symmetric sides read.
represents.fix: Add a small green/yellow check mark to show it's a check.

distinct.evidence: Red line across a shape echoes Clearance and Symmetrize.
distinct.fix: Make the red line a vertical dashed axis.

legibility.evidence: Wings blur slightly at 1x.
legibility.fix: Larger wings with a clear notch at the centre.

represents.evidence: Cream grid sheet with a red dot: looks like graph paper.
represents.fix: Grey surface with a bold light quad wireframe and a red pole vertex/bad face highlighted.

distinct.evidence: Close to Dissolve tile and Paint maps sheet.
distinct.fix: Use grey mesh, not cream paper.

legibility.evidence: Grid lines vanish at 1x.

distinct.evidence: Different from Corrective.

represents.evidence: Speech/note bubble with text lines next to a cube.
